description:
Ready to lead, disrupt and reinvent the sleep industry?





We are Emma – The Sleep Company. Founded in 2015, we have grown into the world’s largest direct-to-consumer (D2C) sleep brand, with a presence in over 20 markets and more than 35 Emma stores across Europe. 










Our mission is simple: to develop sleep comfort products that empower our customers to awaken their best every day. Today, our products are trusted by millions and recommended by leading consumer associations worldwide. 










It’s our people who bring this mission to life. At Emma, you’ll join a driven, international team that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous knowledge sharing. With colleagues from over 70 nationalities, we combine diverse perspectives with a shared ambition to learn, grow, and create lasting impact, together. 










Ready to awaken your best with us? 







What you will do:


Content Creation & A/B Testing: Support the creation of marketing assets for specific campaigns and learn how to run A/B tests to identify the most effective creative and messaging approaches


Strategy Development: Assist in designing and optimizing marketing strategies aimed at building brand awareness and driving performance across different marketplaces


Performance Monitoring: Help track and analyze key marketing KPIs, providing insights and recommendations to improve results under the guidance of senior team members


Ad Optimization: Support in managing and optimizing marketplace ads, ensuring they effectively reach target audiences and deliver strong ROAS


Content Optimization: Contribute to improving product listings by updating titles, crafting engaging descriptions, and selecting visually appealing images that increase conversion rates


Cross-Team Collaboration: Work closely with other teams to help develop cohesive and impactful marketing campaigns that align with overall brand goals


Analysis: Conduct data analysis to evaluate campaign effectiveness, identify trends, and provide actionable insights to support decision-making


Executional Day-to-Day Tasks: Assist with daily operational and administrative activities such as processing invoices, preparing reports, and maintaining documentation to ensure smooth campaign execution


Proactive Learning: Show initiative, adaptability, and a willingness to learn in a fast-paced environment, progressively taking more ownership of tasks with team guidance








What we are looking for:


You are on your last semester of your Bachelor’s degree or recently graduated


You have excellent communication and interpersonal skills


You have a strong sense of ownership and initiative. 


You have a strong affinity for critical thinking, hands-on execution, problem-solving, and result orientation.  


Comfortable with Excel and Numbers: Is more than proficcient in Excel, and considered data-driven








What we offer:


Salary of $18,000 (MXN)


Food vouchers


Hybrid home office policy (60-40)


Pet-friendly office


A combination of personal and company growth to accelerate your career and help you reach your goals


The chance to work on exciting and challenging projects either independently or as part of a dedicated, international team


Responsibility and decision-making authority from day one—you'll create an impact with new, innovative ideas and help shape our company DNA












Become an Emmie 








We are on a mission to become No.1 in the world of sleep, and we’re looking for driven, ambitious people to help us shape what’s next. If you’re curious, hands-on, and ready to challenge the status quo, you’ll find the space here to make things happen and create real impact.  










We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building an inclusive workplace. We celebrate diversity and consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, ethnic origin, religion or belief, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or age. 










Our aim is to get back to you within a few days. Due to the high volume of applications, there may be slight delays, but we’ll get back to you as soon as possible.   







Upon your consent, we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as get the interviews transcript and summarised by AI. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgement. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please reach out to privacy@emma-sleep.com

description:
Marketing Intern (Apprentice) – Saba

Are you passionate about marketing, data, and understanding what drives brand growth? This is an opportunity to develop your career working with Saba, contributing to real marketing projects and turning market and consumer information into meaningful business insights.

About The Role

At Essity, we are looking for a Marketing Intern to join the Saba Marketing team in Santa Fe, Mexico City.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to learn how a consumer goods brand is managed from an end-to-end perspective, combining brand strategy, business and consumer analysis, and point-of-sale execution.

You will work with sales, market share, pricing, competitive, and profitability data, while also contributing to innovation projects, product launches, and portfolio management. You will collaborate closely with teams such as Sales, Finance, Consumer Insights, Trade Marketing, and Regulatory Affairs, as well as external agencies.

We are looking for someone who is curious, proactive, and analytical, but above all, eager to learn and take ownership of projects from start to finish.

We are looking for people who embody our values, who are not afraid to challenge, innovate, experiment, and move at a fast pace. We are always looking for ways to improve our products and ourselves. If this sounds like you, we’d love to talk.

What You Will Do


Support the development and execution of marketing initiatives and brand strategies for Saba, while contributing to innovation, product launches, and portfolio projects.
Analyze market and business information to identify trends, opportunities, and risks based on indicators such as Sales In, Sales Out, market share, P&L, and pricing.
Monitor competitors and category performance, including promotions, pricing dynamics, and relevant market trends, to generate insights and recommendations.
Follow up on point-of-sale execution across channels such as supermarkets, pharmacies, and hard discount, including store visits to gain a deeper understanding of consumers and market dynamics.
Conduct consumer and category analyses and research, using quantitative and qualitative information to support business decisions.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams and external agencies, following up on projects, owners, timelines, and deliverables to ensure successful execution.
Prepare business reports and executive presentations, turning complex data and information into clear messages and actionable recommendations.


Who You Are


You are currently studying Marketing, Business Administration, Finance, Engineering, Economics, or a related field, with approximately 18 months remaining before graduation.
You have advanced English proficiency, both written and spoken, enabling you to work with international information and teams.
You have a good command of Excel and are comfortable working with databases, pivot tables, lookup functions, formulas, and charts.
You have an analytical mindset and enjoy going beyond the data to understand what it means and what business opportunities it may reveal.
You are proactive, curious, and eager to learn, with the ability to research, ask questions, and suggest new ways of doing things.
You demonstrate a strong sense of ownership and accountability, following up on your tasks and projects through completion.
You are organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high-quality deliverables.
You communicate clearly, enjoy working with different stakeholders, and build strong relationships to move projects forward.


It will be a plus if you have experience or familiarity with PowerPoint, Nielsen, Power BI, or other market data sources, or if you are interested in point-of-sale execution and understanding consumer behavior.

What We Can Offer You

Our purpose, Breaking Barriers to Well-being, provides meaning to everything we do. Join us to improve well-being for people and drive positive change for society and the environment. At Essity, you will feel valued, have opportunities to grow, and be challenged to deliver business results in an open and collaborative environment.

Innovate for Good | Excel Together | Be You with Us

Strategic Student Program (SSP) – Marketing & Events Intern

Discover your career with us at Siemens Digital Industries Software!

We are a leading global software company dedicated to helping innovative companies transform the way they design, engineer and manufacture products. With the resources of a global organization and the energy of a technology-driven environment, our culture encourages creativity, fresh thinking, collaboration and continuous growth.

We are currently recruiting students for our Mexico Strategic Student Program. Our internship opportunities are designed to provide students with meaningful, hands-on experience where they can apply their education to real business challenges, develop new capabilities and gain exposure to different teams, partners, customers and leaders.

About The Role

The Marketing & Events Intern will be an active member of the Mexico Marketing team, supporting the planning and execution of marketing programs across events, digital channels, communications, demand generation and partner activities.

The person joining the team will have ownership of specific activities and projects and will work closely with Marketing, Sales, Channel Partners, vendors and other internal and external stakeholders.

The role requires someone who is proactive, organized, comfortable communicating with different audiences and willing to take ownership from planning through execution and follow-up.

Previous professional experience is not required. However, we are looking for students who can demonstrate initiative, problem-solving, teamwork and ownership through academic projects, student organizations, competitions, volunteering, entrepreneurship, events or other relevant experiences.

Key Responsibilities

Events & Experiences

Support the end-to-end planning and execution of in-person and digital events, including customer events, webinars, seminars, conferences, partner activities and other marketing experiences.

Responsibilities may include:


Support event planning, timelines, logistics and coordination from initial concept through execution and post-event follow-up.
Coordinate with internal teams, external vendors, venues, speakers, partners and sponsors.
Support vendor communication, quotations, deliverables and execution requirements.
Develop and maintain event timelines, checklists and run-of-show documents.
Support on-site execution and ensure activities, suppliers and deliverables are coordinated according to plan.
Support virtual and digital event execution when applicable.
Coordinate event communications, including Save the Dates, invitations, reminders, teasers and follow-up communications.
Support registration processes and registration pages.
Collect attendee feedback through post-event surveys and other feedback mechanisms.
Review event results, participant feedback and generated opportunities to identify learnings and opportunities for future optimization.
Prepare event recaps and communicate key results and insights to relevant stakeholders.


Digital Marketing & Social Media

Support and help execute the digital and social media strategy for the Mexico organization, with particular focus on LinkedIn and other relevant digital channels.

Responsibilities may include:


Support the development and execution of the LinkedIn content calendar.
Identify relevant company, customer, partner and industry content that can be amplified through our channels.
Create and adapt social media assets and copy.
Publish events, company updates, relevant news and marketing content.
Monitor engagement and incoming interactions and ensure appropriate follow-up when needed.
Stay informed about relevant industry trends, news and conversations to identify potential content opportunities.
Track channel performance and identify opportunities to improve engagement and content effectiveness.
Coordinate with internal stakeholders to identify stories, activities and business priorities that should be communicated through digital channels.


Marketing Programs & Campaign Execution

Support the execution of marketing programs aligned with business priorities for both the Direct Sales and Channel organizations.

Responsibilities may include:


Work closely with Marketing, Sales and Channel teams to understand business priorities and translate them into marketing activities.
Support demand generation and communication campaigns throughout their execution.
Coordinate activities with partners and follow up on agreed marketing initiatives and deliverables.
Support the implementation and adoption of marketing execution best practices.
Help coordinate multiple marketing activities simultaneously while maintaining visibility of timelines, stakeholders and deliverables.
Support campaign execution and follow-up, including reviewing results and identifying potential optimization opportunities.
Collaborate with different stakeholders to ensure activities remain aligned with current business priorities.


Content & Marketing Asset Development

Support the creation, adaptation and execution of marketing and communication materials across different channels.

This may include:


Flyers and digital invitations
Email communications and email campaigns
Social media assets
Videos and short-form content
Event teasers
Save the Dates
Posters and event signage
Presentations
Registration pages
Landing pages
Web content

Company Description

About Etéreo, Auberge Collection

Etéreo, Auberge Collection is located on Mexico’s Riviera Maya, within the luxury Kanai development just 30 miles from Cancun International Airport. Set within a protected mangrove forest along a pristine stretch of the Caribbean Sea, the resort offers 75 luxury accommodations—ranging from 875 sq. ft. Studios to 3,925 sq. ft. three-bedroom Penthouse Suites. Each oceanview retreat features expansive private terraces with floor-to-ceiling glass doors, spa-style bathrooms with dual vanities and soaking tubs, and thoughtful design that blurs the line between indoors and out. From outdoor adventures that immerse guests in the region’s natural wonders to hands-on experiences with local artisans, the resort’s on- and off-site programming is designed to celebrate the vibrancy of the Yucatán and its rich cultural heritage. The resort’s signature dining venue, Itzam, showcases elevated modern Mexican cuisine with a focus on local ingredients, complemented by panoramic ocean views from its open-air seating, lounge terrace, and private dining room, Pixán. description:
About Us




At Félix, we are building the indispensable financial companion for Latinos in the US. We combine an AI-powered, conversational-first interface with real-time financial infrastructure to make cross-border money movement as easy as sending a text. Starting with fast, affordable remittances powered by AI and crypto rails, we are expanding into credit, savings, and wallet services to support the complete immigrant financial journey. Our ambition is to deliver a white-glove financial experience with the simplicity of a conversation to a community the traditional financial system has historically overlooked.




We are a hyper-growth Series C company, backed by over $300 million in funding from top-tier global investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, QED, Castle Island, Switch Ventures, HTwenty, Monashees, General Catalyst Customer Value Fund. This isn't just about the numbers; it's a testament to the trust our investors have in our vision and our team. Additionally, Félix was selected as an “Endeavour Entrepreneur” and was a recipient of the CrossTech Fintech Startups Award.




Joining Félix means you will be part of a team building a legacy, a company that will outlive us all. This is a rare opportunity to apply your skills to a deeply meaningful mission—serving a community that has been underserved for too long because we are obsessed with our customers. We get things done with urgency and focus, driven by extreme ownership over our impact. We collaborate without ego, fostering radical transparency and fierce loyalty so we can grow together. Because we aim for insanely great rather than just good enough, we stay insatiably curious—always experimenting, building the future today, and delivering a product that truly makes our users' lives better.




About the role




As strategic Social Media Content Manager you own and elevate Félix's social media presence. In this role, you are responsible for building a proactive content engine — moving the team from reactive to intentional across every platform. You own the full content cycle, from strategy and planning to production and execution, ensuring every piece is on-brand, platform-right, and always a step ahead. A key part of this role is translating brand and campaign priorities into organic social executions, continuously improving what gets published, and keeping production, design, and partners unblocked at all times.




Responsibilities




Strategy and Planning

Own the content strategy: pillars, formats, campaign arcs, and seasonal angles aligned to brand and business goals
Build and maintain a rolling content calendar — planned ahead to keep production, design, and partners unblocked, while staying agile enough to jump on trends and cultural moments as they happen
Translate hero campaigns and brand initiatives into organic social media executions across all channels
Analyze performance regularly — identify what's working and turn insights into strategy, not just reporting
Continuously audit and improve content quality: formats, tone, visual language, and platform fit
Manage relationships with creative partners and providers — from briefing and production oversight to delivery QA and invoicing
Partner with the Paid Social team to ensure organic and paid content strategies are aligned and mutually reinforcing




Production and Execution

Own the copy creation process — from briefing to final copy — adapting tone per platform, campaign, and audience
Brief, direct, and QA all creative partners and providers
Own production of static and short-form content in collaboration with the design team and/or agency
Manage the creative pipeline and design tickets
Lead content tropicalization and localization efforts




Collaboration (receives, doesn't produce)

Receives community insights, trend signals, and curated user profiles from Community Manager to inform strategy and content creation where applicable.
Receives engagement and sentiment data — does not generate these reports




Key Metrics

Planning lead time: Calendar always sufficiently ahead of publishing
Content quality: Pillar coverage and format variety per cycle
Platform growth: Reach, impressions and follower base month over month
Production health: Partners on brief, no last-minute blocks
Website traffic & signups: Sessions and sign-ups driven from organic social content via UTM tracking




Requirements




4+ years of content strategy and creation experience: Proven track record of defining and executing content strategies across digital and social channels, from setting the editorial vision to measuring impact, preferably within high-growth startups, B2C tech, or fintech.
On-camera presence & video production: Comfortable and confident being the on-screen face of the brand ("mostrarse en redes"), with hands-on skills in conceptualizing, filming, and editing short-form video (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts).
End-to-end scriptwriting & narrative storytelling: Strong scriptwriting capabilities with an innate ability to spot emerging cultural and social trends, translating complex product features and brand positioning into relatable, human-centered stories.
Workflow & channel management: Hands-on experience defining the role of each channel, managing publishing rhythms, and growing engaged communities on conversation-driven platforms (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, X).
Editorial planning & partner collaboration: Demonstrated experience owning content calendars and managing cross-functional production pipelines, including collaborating with external agencies, creators, and freelance partners.
Data-informed content strategy: Ability to analyze engagement metrics, video completion rate, and audience insights to evaluate performance, test hypotheses, and continuously iterate on content creative strategy.
Extreme ownership & proactive execution: Highly organized self-starter with a strong bias for action, capable of navigating ambiguity, prioritizing high-impact initiatives, and executing under fast-paced startup deadlines.
Language proficiency: Native Spanish speaker with advanced professional English proficiency (spoken and written).




These are the applicable requisites, although equivalent competencies in any of the above will also be considered.

Job description:

Introduction

Do you want to work with a top performer? So do we! We’re Katun Corporation, and we’re looking for a talented Marketing Analyst -Monitoring and Reporting to join our performance-proven team of professionals.

For over 40 years, Katun has been one of the world’s leading providers of OEM-compatible imaging supplies, photoreceptors, and parts for copiers, printers, MFPs, and other imaging equipment. From our humble beginnings in 1979, we pioneered and helped legitimize the imaging supplies aftermarket. Today, we serve 10,000 customers in 116 countries from our headquarters in Minneapolis and dozens of worldwide locations. We believe that in order for people and businesses to prosper, we must protect the environment first, as a healthy planet and a healthy community go hand in hand. This applies to our local and global communities as well.

Position Summary

The Marketing Analyst plays a crucial operational and analytical role within Katun's Marketing team. This position is responsible for executing, managing, and continuously improving commercial tools and activities across promotions, pricing, e-commerce, reporting, and internal platforms. The analyst supports day-to-day operations and contributes to strategic decision-making through detailed data management, follow-up, and cross-functional coordination.

Key Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Marketing Promotions

· Create and execute promotional campaigns in coordination with Sales and Marketing teams.

· Analyze the impact of promotions on sales, gross margin, and product turnover.

· Manage the lifecycle and performance tracking of all active and historical campaigns.

· Lead Results Meetings to present outcomes and key insights from completed promotions.

Rebates

· Define, manage, and follow up on rebate programs based on past performance and growth targets.

At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the microphone and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. title: Key Account Manager - POS
description:
🚀 Buscamos un/a Key Account Manager (KAM) para el área de Payments en México. 




En AgendaPro le damos tecnología a miles de emprendedores de belleza, salud y bienestar de LATAM para que se enfoquen en lo que aman hacer. Partimos con un software de agenda y gestión, pero hoy somos mucho más: creamos agentes customizados de IA que atienden, agendan y venden por cada negocio 24/7, les resolvemos los pagos con nuestra propia solución fintech, y construimos un marketplace que los conecta con nuevos clientes. Vamos a ser la plataforma completa sobre la que funciona cada negocio local de la región. Somos parte de Y Combinator, levantamos una Serie B de US$35M y avanzamos a toda velocidad, con IA en el centro de lo que viene.




No te pedimos que lo sepas todo, sino que tengas ganas de aprender rápido y de construir lo que todavía no existe. En AgendaPro nos movemos con energía y velocidad: acá la ejecución pesa más que la estrategia y todos somos hands on. Vas a trabajar con tecnología de punta, resolver problemas reales y tener el espacio para dejar tu marca desde el primer día. Buscamos gente con hambre, que compita en equipo para ganar, que no le tenga miedo a construir tomando riesgos y que se entrene constantemente. Detrás de cada cosa que construimos hay un negocio real confiando en nosotros, y queremos que seas parte de eso.




📍 Modalidad 100% presencial – base en México, con disponibilidad para visitar comercios.




🚀 Qué harás / Responsabilidades:

• Vender POS a los comercios de nuestra base actual y cumplir (o reventar) tus metas de venta.

• Gestión activa de cartera: contacto proactivo y sostenido con los comercios de alto valor (llamadas, visitas presenciales, revisión de métricas de procesamiento por merchant).

• Subir la penetración GPV/GMV del POS: mover a cada comercio sobre el umbral (≥50%) y empujarlo hacia 60% / 70%; diagnosticar por qué cada uno no procesa más (fricción técnica, UX, preferencia por competidor, desconocimiento de features) y cerrar la brecha.

• Ganarle al arbitraje: detectar los comercios que usan AgendaPro pero también procesan tarjeta en un POS de la competencia, y recuperar ese volumen para nosotros.

• Retención / anti-churn: intervenir apenas una cuenta cae bajo el umbral o muestra señales de fuga.

• Aplicar pricing táctico dentro de los guardrails definidos.

• Coordinar con el equipo comercial en Chile: asumes la relación comercial y coordinas la mantención con operación y soporte, escalando los temas operativos y de producto a las contrapartes internas.

• Recibir los comercios recién activados (desde activación / onboarding) y asumir su relación de crecimiento.

• Reportar avance: alimentar los dashboards de penetración, GPV por cuenta y arbitraje, y participar en los ritmos semanales del equipo de Payments.




Requisitos: 

• Formación en Administración de Empresas, Mercadotecnia, Ingeniería Industrial o carrera afín.

• Base en Ciudad de México, con disponibilidad para visitar comercios.

• 2–4 años en account management / KAM / customer success o gestión de cartera B2B, idealmente en medios de pago, servicios financieros, SaaS o tecnología para comercios.

• Perfil hunter comprobable: track record de vender y crecer revenue, con hambre de cierre y foco en la meta.

• Orientación a GPV (volumen procesado), no a número de llamadas; track record de crecer revenue/engagement en cartera existente, no solo adquisición.

• Capacidad de leer data y dashboards, identificar patrones y priorizar comercios por oportunidad.

• Comunicación empática pero directa; cómodo visitando comercios y teniendo conversaciones difíciles.

• Autonomía y disciplina de seguimiento; trabaja en equipo con los hunters y activación sin competir (roles complementarios).




Suma puntos:

• Experiencia en medios de pago, servicios financieros, SaaS o tecnología para comercios.

• Experiencia en el sector belleza, salud o bienestar.

• Conocimiento del ecosistema de pagos mexicano (Clip, Mercado Pago, Getnet, Netpay, bancos adquirentes)

Keurig Dr Pepper (Nasdaq: KDP) es una empresa líder en bebidas con más de 150 marcas propias, licenciadas y asociadas que satisfacen una amplia variedad de necesidades y ocasiones. Nuestro negocio de bebidas refrescantes en Norteamérica ocupa posiciones de liderazgo en refrescos carbonatados, agua, jugos y mezcladores, con un portafolio de marcas icónicas como as Dr Pepper®, Canada Dry®, Mott’s®, A&W®, Peñafiel®, GHOST®, 7UP®, Snapple®, Clamato® y Core Hydration®. Nuestro negocio global de café abarca más de 100 mercados e incluye el sistema líder de preparación de café individual Keurig® en Estados Unidos y Canadá, junto con marcas de gran prestigio como Peet’s, L’OR y Jacobs, además de otros líderes regionales en café. Nuestros más de 50,000 empleados buscan mejorar la experiencia de cada ocasión de bebidas y café, mientras generan un impacto positivo para las personas, las comunidades y el planeta.

Nos esforzamos por ser un empleador de preferencia, ofreciendo una cultura y oportunidades que empoderan a nuestro equipo para crecer y desarrollarse. Brindamos beneficios sólidos para apoyar su salud y bienestar, así como su bienestar personal y financiero. title: Brand & Creative Strategist
skills: Conceptualización creativa de campañas: Desarrollar los conceptos creativos de cada campaña, definiendo la idea central, el mensaje rector, el enfoque visual y el tono de comunicación. Elaborar briefs estratégicos para los equipos de Diseño, Copy y agencias externas.

Estrategia creativa para Paid Media: Supervisar que las piezas publicitarias de los distintos canales (Meta, Google, LinkedIn, TikTok, entre otros) estén alineadas con los objetivos de adquisición, considerando audiencia, etapa del funnel, propuesta de valor, llamados a la acción y KPIs.

Optimización basada en resultados: Colaborar estrechamente con el equipo de Paid Media para analizar el desempeño de las piezas, identificar los mensajes y formatos con mejores resultados e incorporar estos aprendizajes en futuras campañas.

Consistencia de marca y performance: Equilibrar la identidad y posicionamiento de marca con los objetivos de conversión, desarrollando piezas que generen resultados sin comprometer la percepción ni la consistencia de Skydropx.

Investigación de temporalidades y oportunidades comerciales: Identificar y analizar fechas relevantes para México, Colombia y Brasil, incluyendo eventos comerciales (Hot Sale, Buen Fin, Black Friday, Cyber Monday, Navidad, Día de las Madres, Día sin IVA en Colombia, entre otros), temporadas de alta demanda logística y momentos clave para emprendedores y negocios de e-commerce.

Planeación de campañas estacionales: Construir y mantener un calendario anual de temporalidades y oportunidades comerciales. Colaborar en la definición de campañas por mercado, objetivos, prioridades y tiempos de ejecución.
Estrategia y posicionamiento de marca: Apoyar al Brand Manager en el desarrollo y evolución de la estrategia de marca, contribuyendo a consolidar a Skydropx como referente en soluciones logísticas.

Identidad y lineamientos de comunicación: Trabajar en conjunto con la Líder de Diseño para mantener actualizados el brand book, la guía de tono de voz y el framework de mensajes clave por audiencia y mercado.
Análisis de mercado y competencia: Monitorear a competidores, tendencias de las industrias logística y de e-commerce, así como la percepción y posicionamiento de la marca.
Oportunidades de diferenciación: Identificar y proponer territorios de comunicación, mensajes y estrategias creativas que fortalezcan la diferenciación de Skydropx en el mercado.

Indicadores de marca: Dar seguimiento a métricas de salud de marca, como awareness, consistencia, sentimiento y share of voice, para identificar oportunidades de mejora y evaluar el impacto de las iniciativas.
Formación académica: Licenciatura en Mercadotecnia, Ciencias de la Comunicación, Publicidad, Diseño Gráfico, Diseño de la Comunicación Visual o carreras afines.
Experiencia en análisis e interpretación de métricas y KPIs de marca, como alcance, engagement, share of voice, sentimiento y NPS.
Manejo de herramientas de analítica y monitoreo, como Google Analytics, Meta Business Suite y plataformas de social listening (Brandwatch, Sprout Social, Hootsuite).
Manejo de Excel o Google Sheets a nivel intermedio para la elaboración de reportes y análisis de información.
Experiencia en la construcción e implementación de lineamientos de marca (brand guidelines / brand book), incluyendo identidad visual, tono de voz, mensajes clave y arquitectura de marca.
Conocimiento de fundamentos de posicionamiento, propuesta de valor y diferenciación frente a la competencia.
Conocimientos en investigación de mercado y análisis de audiencias: buyer personas, encuestas, focus groups y estudios de percepción de marca (brand awareness y brand health).
Habilidades y competencias
Comunicación efectiva: Capacidad para comunicar ideas de manera clara y persuasiva, tanto oralmente como por escrito, presentar propuestas y argumentar decisiones de marca ante diferentes áreas.
Storytelling: Habilidad para transformar atributos y valores de marca en historias y mensajes relevantes que conecten con las audiencias.
Redacción y ortografía: Excelente dominio de la escritura, con atención a la claridad, coherencia y correcta aplicación del lenguaje.
Pensamiento estratégico: Capacidad para comprender el impacto de cada iniciativa en el posicionamiento y construcción de marca a largo plazo.
Visión de negocio: Habilidad para alinear las estrategias y decisiones de marca con los objetivos comerciales de la organización.
Pensamiento analítico: Capacidad para interpretar datos, identificar tendencias y tomar decisiones fundamentadas en información y evidencia.
Criterio estético y atención al detalle: Sensibilidad visual para identificar inconsistencias y asegurar la coherencia de los elementos gráficos y mensajes de marca.
Organización y gestión de prioridades: Capacidad para administrar varios proyectos simultáneamente, cumplir tiempos de entrega y mantener la calidad de los resultados.
Trabajo colaborativo: Habilidad para trabajar con equipos multidisciplinarios, como Ventas, Producto, Diseño y agencias externas.
Apertura al feedback: Capacidad para dar y recibir retroalimentación de manera constructiva, integrando mejoras en su trabajo.
Orientación a resultados: Enfoque en el cumplimiento de objetivos, indicadores y fechas de entrega.
Misión a nivel regional: lograr que los negocios de LATAM se despreocupen de su logística.
Salario: Competitivo y negociable según experiencia, habilidades y resultados del proceso de contratación.
Desarrollo y crecimiento profesional.
Herramientas de trabajo.

title: Auxiliar de diseño
description:
Auxiliar de Diseño




En La Tradicional de Salgado buscamos integrar a nuestro equipo a un(a) Auxiliar de Diseño con creatividad, criterio visual y atención al detalle, que contribuya al desarrollo de contenido y materiales de comunicación para nuestra marca.




Buscamos una persona con iniciativa, disposición para aprender y capacidad para trabajar en equipo, que tenga interés en desarrollar proyectos de diseño, fotografía y contenido audiovisual dentro de una empresa con más de 166 años de tradición.




Descripción del puesto:




Como Auxiliar de Diseño, apoyarás en la creación y adaptación de materiales gráficos y audiovisuales para los diferentes canales de comunicación de La Tradicional de Salgado, asegurando que cada pieza mantenga la identidad visual y los lineamientos de nuestra marca.




Participarás en proyectos de diseño para redes sociales, campañas, puntos de venta y eventos, así como en la producción de fotografía y video de productos y actividades de la empresa.




Algunas responsabilidades:




•⁠ ⁠Diseñar y adaptar contenido para redes sociales de acuerdo con los lineamientos de marca.

•⁠ ⁠Apoyar en el desarrollo de materiales gráficos para campañas publicitarias y de comunicación.

•⁠ ⁠Diseñar materiales para medios digitales e impresos.

•⁠ ⁠Crear materiales gráficos para tiendas y puntos de venta.

•⁠ ⁠Apoyar en el desarrollo de materiales para eventos y actividades de la empresa.

•⁠ ⁠Realizar fotografía de producto y apoyar en sesiones fotográficas.

•⁠ ⁠Realizar levantamientos de fotografía y video en eventos, recorridos y actividades de la empresa.

•⁠ ⁠Grabar y editar contenido audiovisual para redes sociales, incluyendo reels.

•⁠ ⁠Apoyar en la edición básica de fotografía y video.

•⁠ ⁠Colaborar en proyectos relacionados con la imagen y comunicación visual de la marca.




Requisitos:




•⁠ ⁠Licenciatura concluida en Diseño Gráfico, Diseño Digital, Diseño y Comunicación Visual o carrera afín.

•⁠ ⁠Se consideran perfiles recién egresados; preferentemente con 1 año de experiencia en un puesto similar.

•⁠ ⁠Manejo de Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign y Premiere.

•⁠ ⁠Conocimientos de fotografía y video.

•⁠ ⁠Conocimientos de edición de fotografía y video.

•⁠ ⁠Conocimiento de contenido para redes sociales.

•⁠ ⁠Manejo de sistemas operativos Windows y Mac.

•⁠ ⁠Disponibilidad para realizar levantamientos de fotografía y video cuando las actividades de la empresa lo requieran.

•⁠ ⁠Portafolio de trabajo indispensable.




Competencias:




•⁠ ⁠Creatividad.

•⁠ ⁠Criterio visual.

•⁠ ⁠Atención al detalle.

•⁠ ⁠Organización y planeación.

•⁠ ⁠Comunicación efectiva.

•⁠ ⁠Trabajo en equipo.

•⁠ ⁠Proactividad.

•⁠ ⁠Capacidad de resolución de problemas.

•⁠ ⁠Adaptabilidad.

•⁠ ⁠Buena redacción y ortografía.




Horario:




Lunes a viernes: 9:00 a.m. a 5:00 p.m.

Sábados: 9:00 a.m. a 2:00 p.m.




📍 Lugar de trabajo: Celaya, Guanajuato.

🏢 Modalidad: Presencial.




¿Qué ofrecemos?




•⁠ ⁠Prestaciones de ley.

•⁠ ⁠Día de descanso con goce de sueldo por tu cumpleaños.

•⁠ ⁠Descuento en productos de la empresa.

•⁠ ⁠Desarrollo profesional.

Si cuentas con el perfil que buscamos y quieres desarrollar tu talento en diseño, fotografía y contenido audiovisual, queremos conocerte.

mercadotecnia@latradicionaldesalgado.com

Learn to operate a world-class acquisition program that brings in millions of orders to DoorDash, making it the top food delivery and logistics platform in the U.S.. working with our U.S. based

description:
About the Team

The Consumer Performance Marketing team owns the execution of paid social acquisition across Meta, TikTok, and Snapchat. We operate at scale across the U.S. and Canada, managing complex builds, pacing routines, live optimizations, QA workflows, and experiment cycles that directly impact consumer growth.

We work closely with U.S.-based Channel Managers, Creative, Analytics, and Martech, functioning as one integrated performance engine. This requires strong operational discipline, fast signal interpretation, and a mindset focused on translating platform behavior into clear, actionable steps.

While the team is execution-heavy, we also influence strategy by shaping testing agendas, surfacing insights, and partnering with platform reps on betas and new product rollouts. It's a high-ownership environment for operators who thrive in fast, data-driven systems.

About the Role

This role owns the tactical execution of Consumer paid social campaigns end-to-end. You will build, QA, pace, optimize, and iterate campaigns across Meta, TikTok, and Snap, managing multi-million-dollar budgets with precision.

You'll partner with U.S. teams and platform reps to run experiments, test new bidding approaches, evaluate audience structures, and support creative testing. You will also be expected to diagnose issues quickly, communicate insights clearly, and maintain structurally sound accounts.

This position requires someone who can execute with technical depth, think analytically, and move fast — ensuring each optimization ties directly to performance outcomes.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…


Be a part of our first DoorDash team in our Mexico City office! 
Manage multi-million dollar monthly digital budgets across digital paid marketing channels, working with partners such as Meta, Snap, Google and TikTok to optimize campaign performance and test new products.
Learn to operate a world-class acquisition program that brings in millions of orders to DoorDash, making it the top food delivery and logistics platform in the U.S.. working with our U.S. based
Maintain and monitor key metrics across channels including budget pacing, cost per acquisition and LTV proxies.
Manage an experimentation roadmap to optimize performance including A/B creative tests, incrementality tests, and bidding algo tests
Work closely with other teams and stakeholders to ensure goals are met


We're excited about you because…


You are proficient in the English language 
You have a proven track record in the performance marketing space, with 4+ years of experience.
Direct, hands-on experience managing media buying, optimization (Paid Social), and strategic planning either at an agency or in-house
You are highly proficient in Excel/Google Sheets and have deep familiarity with metrics such as CPA, CPC, CVR, and LTV.
Strong quantitative, analytical and problem-solving skills; must be very comfortable with data analysis and able to use data to make decisions and conduct experiments.
Experience with Web & App Tracking/Attribution (preferred)
Knowledge of SQL (preferred)
Experience working on multi-sided marketplace businesses (preferred)


About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.

description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Role Summary And Impact

As part of the Global Operations Centre (GOC), you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for a Manager AdOps who will:


Develop strong relationships with counterparts in WPP Media regional teams (Europe, U.S., Asia)  
Enforce best practices with a focus on platform expertise, consistency, and quality of work delivery and be accountable for consistent work delivery to WPP Media regional teams by ensuring a high quality of output.  
Serve as a point of escalation for your team and take ownership of resolving challenges.  
Line manages 2-5 direct reports  
Provide timely and actionable feedback to the team to aid in their development, improvement, and progress. Provide awareness and recognition for jobs that are well done.  


Skills And Experience

If this opportunity looks right for you, we are looking for candidates who have:


Bachelor’s degree. 
Advanced English level (B2–C2). 
Have 3 years of implementing and optimizing programmatic campaigns in CM360 or Sizmek and some experience with Google Ads, Facebook Business Manager, or Dv360. 
At least 1 year of leadership experience. 
Advanced Excel skills.  


Life At WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.

For Mexico

This position is available in a Remote or Hybrid Work Modality. The candidate must perform their work from any location within Mexico. Only Mexican nationals residing in the country or foreign nationals with a valid work permit may apply. Remote work from abroad is not permitted under any circumstances.

Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy ) for more information on how we process the information you provide.

title: Senior Manager, Insights & Analytics, GOC
skills: Report directly to the VP of Investment & Partnerships, connecting media investment strategy with business intelligence and owning the end-to-end data workflow for partner spend forecasting, tracking, and performance validation.
Extract, analyze, and validate spend forecasts from CoreM, WPP Media’s proprietary client spend forecasting dashboard.
Gather and consolidate forecasts across Agency Client Teams, MM&D Solutions, and MM&D Activation, covering programmatic, social, advanced TV, linear TV, radio, out-of-home, and print.
Build and maintain unified reporting models that combine CoreM forecasts with agency, Solutions, and Activation data across deal and non-deal partners.
Produce recurring deal-partner spend pacing reports, identifying trends, risks, and potential shortfalls that could affect trading commitments.
Extract spend pacing data from MediaOcean and reconcile it with vendor delivery data to monitor partner performance.
Investigate and resolve discrepancies between forecasted spend and actual delivery, collaborating with vendors and agency teams to ensure accurate reporting.
Use Canadian market intelligence sources, including nLogic Lens, Comscore, CRTC, and Guideline, to validate investment decisions and contextualize performance.
Develop data-backed presentations and supporting materials for publisher negotiations and strategic partnership reviews.
Identify opportunities to automate data collection and reporting, improving operational efficiency, consistency, and data quality.
Collaborate closely with agency teams, Solutions and Activation specialists, and external media partners to communicate findings and support investment decisions.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Business Analytics, Project Management, or a related field.
3–5 years of professional experience in media planning, media buying, investment, or analytics.
Deep understanding of the Canadian media landscape, including regulators, publishers, and vendor ecosystems.
Experience with media investment and measurement tools such as MediaOcean/Prisma, nLogic Lens and FT, Comscore, and Airware.
Advanced Excel proficiency, including nested formulas, pivot tables, Power Query, and data modeling.

description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Role Summary And Impact

As part of the Global Operations Centre (GOC), you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for a Senior Manager who will:


Report directly to the VP of Investment & Partnerships, connecting media investment strategy with business intelligence and owning the end-to-end data workflow for partner spend forecasting, tracking, and performance validation. 
Extract, analyze, and validate spend forecasts from CoreM, WPP Media’s proprietary client spend forecasting dashboard. 
Gather and consolidate forecasts across Agency Client Teams, MM&D Solutions, and MM&D Activation, covering programmatic, social, advanced TV, linear TV, radio, out-of-home, and print. 
Build and maintain unified reporting models that combine CoreM forecasts with agency, Solutions, and Activation data across deal and non-deal partners. 
Produce recurring deal-partner spend pacing reports, identifying trends, risks, and potential shortfalls that could affect trading commitments. 
Extract spend pacing data from MediaOcean and reconcile it with vendor delivery data to monitor partner performance. 
Investigate and resolve discrepancies between forecasted spend and actual delivery, collaborating with vendors and agency teams to ensure accurate reporting. 
Use Canadian market intelligence sources, including nLogic Lens, Comscore, CRTC, and Guideline, to validate investment decisions and contextualize performance. 
Develop data-backed presentations and supporting materials for publisher negotiations and strategic partnership reviews. 
Identify opportunities to automate data collection and reporting, improving operational efficiency, consistency, and data quality. 
Collaborate closely with agency teams, Solutions and Activation specialists, and external media partners to communicate findings and support investment decisions. 


Skills And Experience


Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Business Analytics, Project Management, or a related field. 
3–5 years of professional experience in media planning, media buying, investment, or analytics. 
Deep understanding of the Canadian media landscape, including regulators, publishers, and vendor ecosystems. 
Experience with media investment and measurement tools such as MediaOcean/Prisma, nLogic Lens and FT, Comscore, and Airware. 
Advanced Excel proficiency, including nested formulas, pivot tables, Power Query, and data modeling. 
Experience using Tableau and/or Power BI to develop dashboards and communicate findings. 
Basic knowledge of SQL is a plus. 
Proficiency in PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook. 
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex datasets and translate findings into actionable recommendations. 
Excellent attention to detail and data quality assurance skills, particularly when validating forecasts, reconciling delivery data, and investigating discrepancies. 
Strong project and time management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple reporting requirements and meet deadlines. 
Effective communication and relationship-building skills for collaborating with agency teams, internal stakeholders, and external media partners. 
A proactive approach to identifying anomalies, investigating their causes, and improving reporting processes. 


Life At WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.

Only candidates residing in either country who are legally authorized to work there may apply. Remote work from outside Mexico or Colombia, including relocation abroad under a remote work contract, is not permitted under any circumstances.

Administrar el P&L de trade por cuenta: presupuesto, ROI y evidencia de ejecución. 
Generar análisis de categoría y shopper como soporte a las negociaciones de los KAMs. 
Diferenciar el rol de dos marcas de café en el anaquel sin canibalizarse, frente a competidores con alta inversión en exhibición y promoción. 
Maximizar el ROI del gasto de trade ante cadenas con alta exigencia de condiciones comerciales y sensibilidad al precio. 

Requisitos

About Teleflex Incorporated

As a global provider of medical technologies, Teleflex is driven by our purpose to improve the health and quality of people’s lives. Through our vision to become the most trusted partner in healthcare, we offer a diverse portfolio with solutions in the therapy areas of anesthesia, emergency medicine, interventional cardiology and radiology, surgical, vascular access, and urology. We believe that the potential of great people, purpose-driven innovation, and world-class products can shape the future direction of healthcare.

Teleflex is the home of Arrow™, Barrigel™, Deknatel™, LMA™, Pilling™, QuikClot™, Rüsch™, UroLift™ and Weck™ – trusted brands united by a common sense of purpose.

At Teleflex, we are empowering the future of healthcare. For more information, please visit teleflex.com.

Latin America - The Latin America Region of Teleflex is headquartered in Morrisville, North Carolina, and supports our customers, distributors, sales managers and specialists in Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Chile, Argentina and Puerto Rico. The Latin America Region sells a broad spectrum of medical devices and related products in the fields of vascular and interventional access, surgical, anesthesia, cardiac care, urology, emergency medicine and respiratory care. As Teleflex grows and expands its portfolio, we will continue to grow our presence in Latin America. Join a dynamic, growing team that offers healthcare providers an array of medical technology solutions that make a difference in patients’ lives.

Position Summary

The Product Manager supports the execution of the Interventional product portfolio strategy across Latin America. Reporting to the Senior Product Manager Interventional, LATAM, this role helps translate customer and market needs into product plans, launches, and commercial programs, while tracking portfolio performance and building product management skills. The Associate Product Manager works closely with regional Sales, global business teams, and cross-functional partners to support clinicians and contribute to business objectives. This position can be based in Mexico City, MX or Bogota, CO.

Principal Responsibilities


 Support day-to-day management of assigned Interventional product lines, including commercial programs, field support, and portfolio performance tracking.
 Help execute product and marketing plans that increase awareness, adoption, and market share across Latin America, coordinating activities and tracking results.
 Gather and analyze data on market trends, customer needs, market size, competitor activity, and product performance; summarize findings and propose recommendations to the Senior Product Manager.
 Support the product lifecycle and roadmap, including market research for opportunity assessments, new product introductions, and launch plan execution, in alignment with regional and global priorities.
 Localize product messaging, campaigns, and sales and marketing materials for regional markets, and provide analysis to support positioning and pricing recommendations.
 Engage with physicians, Cath Lab teams, and Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), alongside the Senior Product Manager and Sales, to gather voice-of-customer insights that inform portfolio and market development plans.
 Support tender and Request for Proposal (RFP) responses, customer communications, product cross-referencing, and routine clinical and commercial inquiries, escalating complex questions as needed.
 Coordinate and follow up with Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Demand Planning, Supply Chain, and global teams on registrations, product availability, quality matters, and regional initiatives.
 Support the company’s presence at regional congresses and education events and uphold the Teleflex Code of Ethics and all company policies and procedures.



Education / Experience Requirements


 Bachelor’s degree required (e.g., Biomedical Engineering, Nursing, Life Sciences, Marketing, or Business).
 2-4 years of experience in product management, preferably within the medical device or healthcare industry.
 Experience managing a product portfolio and developing or executing product launches and marketing plans.
 Medical device experience and familiarity with interventional cardiology, vascular, radiology, or Cath Lab settings preferred.



Specialized Skills / Other Requirements


 Fluent in English and Spanish; Portuguese is a plus.
 Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate clearly with customers and cross-functional partners.
 Ability to analyze market and commercial data, and a strong interest in learning product, marketing, and portfolio management principles.
 Basic understanding of commercial performance drivers, including revenue, pricing, margin, market share, and forecast metrics.
 Strong organizational and follow-through skills; able to prioritize and manage multiple tasks with guidance from the manager.
 Ability to travel up to 40%, including regional travel and occasional short-notice travel.
 Willingness to work in clinical environments, including Cath Labs and other hospital settings.
 Unquestionable integrity and commitment to Teleflex values, compliance, and ethical standards.
 Core competencies must include:
 Passion for the industry
 Drive with focus on results
 Analytical thinking and problem solving
 Collaboration and flexibility
 Time and project management

Do you enjoy working at the intersection of customer insight, technology, and AI while collaborating with global teams to bring impactful product solutions to market?

Elsevier Health applies innovation, facilitates insights, and helps drive more informed decision-making for our customers across global health. We support health providers by providing accessible, trusted evidence-based information; prepare more medical and nursing students with effective tools and resources; provide insights that help clinicians improve patient outcomes; and support a more personalized and localized healthcare experience. All for the benefit of every patient.




About the Role

We are looking for a curious, customer-focused, and technology-oriented Senior Product Manager to help develop innovative healthcare products primarily serving customers in the United States. In this role, you will work closely with customers, engineering teams, and business stakeholders to identify meaningful problems, translate market insights into product opportunities, and guide solutions from discovery through delivery. You will play a key role in exploring AI-enabled approaches and rapid prototyping to create impactful products that improve healthcare experiences and outcomes.

Work in a Way That Works for You

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance, and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.




Working Pattern

Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

description:
About Kueski

At Kueski, we're dedicated to improving the financial lives of people in Mexico. Since 2012, we've been the leading buy now, pay later (BNPL) and online consumer credit platform in Latin America, known for our innovative financial services. Our flagship product, Kueski Pay, provides seamless payment solutions for both online and in-store transactions, establishing itself as the preferred option for nearly 30% of Mexico's top e-commerce merchants. Notably, we were the first to introduce BNPL on Amazon Mexico.

We're a tech company with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration, and impact, fostering a strong, diverse, and inclusive workplace. Our commitment to excellence and ethical business practices has earned us multiple industry recognitions. In 2024, we were named one of the World’s Top FinTech Companies by CNBC and recognized as one of the most ethical companies in Mexico by AMITAI. Additionally, we were certified as a Best Place to Work for LGBTQ+ Equality by HRC Equidad MX 2025 and ranked among the Best Companies for Female Talent by EFY.

Position

The Growth Team Lead is the owner of Kueski’s active customer growth across Kueski Pay and Kueski Cash. This role pairs senior product leadership with commercial ownership to set and commit to active customer targets and chair a standing cross-functional growth team spanning Lending, Marketing, Branding, CX, Data, Account Management, and Credit Risk.

The Growth Team Lead resolves trade-offs across these functions, prioritizes the growth levers that matter most, and builds the foundational infrastructure — lifecycle marketing, attribution, shared metrics — that determines whether every other growth initiative can succeed.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Commercial Ownership


Own the P&L outcome for Kueski’s active customer growth and report progress against targets to executive leadership.
Set and commit to active customer growth targets, then translate those targets into pillar-level goals owned by named cross-functional leads; paired with leading indicators the team can move within an experiment window.
Prioritize the core growth pillars, including pricing and acceptance, activation, repeat usage and habit formation, churn prediction, and reactivation.


Cross-Functional Growth Leadership


Resolve trade-offs between competing functional goals, such as portfolio growth versus customer or merchant experience.
Lead the cross-functional Growth Team spanning Lending, Marketing, Branding, CX, Data, Account Management, and Risk, driving weekly pillar stand-ups and monthly growth reviews.
Partner with Engineering, Design, and Data to scope and sequence foundational and short-term growth product work, including activation, engagement, and retention features.


Experimentation & Growth Measurement


Direct the fix of foundational growth infrastructure — lifecycle marketing enablement, attribution, and the shared growth dashboard — as a prerequisite for reliable retention and lifecycle programs.


Executive Communication & Strategic Alignment


Build narratives that align cross-functional partners around growth strategy, progress, and results, and represent growth priorities in quarterly leadership reviews.


Experience


7+ years in product management, including ownership of cross-functional or multi-product initiatives at scale.
Proven track record owning a growth or lifecycle P&L, or equivalent commercial accountability, ideally in consumer fintech, or consumer lending business.
Experience leading a cross-functional team and resolving trade-offs among stakeholders with competing goals.
Working knowledge of lifecycle marketing and growth infrastructure (e.g., an ESP/CDP such as Braze, attribution, CMS).

title: KAM e-Commerce
description:
The Key Account Manager, eCommerce is responsible for building and accelerating the profitable growth of the assigned category in Mexico’s digital ecosystem, with a focus on Amazon Mexico and/or Mercado Libre.




The role combines commercial ownership of the account with deep expertise in marketplaces, digital shelf, analytics and ecommerce operations. It turns shopper, traffic, conversion, availability, content and pricing data into commercial decisions that drive profitable growth and market share.

More than operating platforms, the role must understand what drives growth on each marketplace, anticipate opportunities and build strategic partnerships with Amazon and/or Mercado Libre. Success requires cross-functional influence across Marketing, Digital Marketing, Customer Marketing, Demand Planning, Supply Chain, Customer Service, Finance and Logistics.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

30% – Commercial Strategy and Channel Planning

• Design and execute the annual category plan by platform, with targets for sales, growth, margin, share, digital distribution and profitability.

• Build the Joint Business Plans (JBP) and growth plans with Amazon Mexico and Mercado Libre, identifying growth drivers, opportunities, risks and joint commitments.

• Define the role of each SKU on each platform, including innovation, bundles and exclusives.

• Identify new digital growth opportunities through assortment expansion, 1P/3P models, special programs and new digital ecosystems.

• Lead the launch and innovation strategy for ecommerce, ensuring availability, content and promotional plans from day one.

• Build the annual commercial calendar by platform, including Prime Day, Hot Sale, Buen Fin, Black Friday and other key events.

• Monitor market, competitor and shopper trends to identify white spaces and share opportunities.

• Evolve the relationship with Vendor Managers, Category Managers and the commercial teams at Amazon and/or Mercado Libre from transactional to strategic growth partnership.

Key KPIs: Net Sales/Sell-out · Growth · Market/Category Share · Incremental Sales · Gross Margin/Contribution · Innovation Sales · JBP Delivery.




20% – P&L, Forecast and Supply

• Manage the category P&L by platform and key SKUs, understanding the real economics of the business from Invoice Sales to Gross Margin.

• Define the pricing, assortment and channel strategy to balance growth and profitability while protecting brand equity and price consistency across channels.

• Lead forecast and demand planning with Supply Chain by platform and SKU, anticipating needs for events, launches and peak periods.

• Monitor forecast accuracy, availability, OOS, Confirmation Rate, Fill Rate, inventory health and sell-through.

• Ensure enough inventory to capture demand without excess or aged stock, using the applicable fulfillment models (Vendor Flex, FBA, Mercado Libre Full).

• Manage commercial investments within approved guidelines and budget, ensuring ROI and documentation.

• Work with Finance on chargebacks, shortage claims and reconciliations, keeping commercial accountability.

• Develop scenarios and recommendations that balance growth, availability, investment, pricing and profitability.

Key KPIs: Net Sales · Gross Margin/Contribution · Forecast Accuracy · Availability/OOS · Confirmation Rate · Fill Rate · Inventory Health · Chargebacks.

30% – Digital Shelf and Platform Management

• Manage the digital shelf as the online equivalent of the Perfect Store, ensuring priority SKUs meet standards for availability, findability, content, competitiveness and conversion.

• Ensure catalog health and quality on Amazon and/or Mercado Libre: listings, ASINs, variants, categorization, attributes and incident resolution.

• Lead continuous optimization of digital content: titles, images, videos, A+ Content, Brand Stores and platform-specific assets.

• Improve searchability and discoverability through keyword research, content quality and marketplace best practices.

• Monitor organic ranking, traffic, CTR, CVR, ratings, reviews and availability, identifying root causes of performance gaps and defining corrective actions.

• Drive operational excellence in Amazon Vendor Central, Seller Central and Mercado Libre: orders, promotions, availability, incidents and account health.

• Work with Customer Marketing and Marketing to produce and update digital assets that keep the brand consistent.

• Use ratings, reviews and shopper questions as insight into product, content and experience opportunities.

Key KPIs: Availability/OOS · Organic Ranking · PDP Traffic · CTR · CVR · Content Quality/Completeness · Ratings & Reviews · Catalog Health.

20% – Analytics and Insights

• Analyze the digital funnel (Traffic → PDP → CVR → Sales) to find whether a performance gap comes from traffic, content, availability, competitiveness or conversion.

• Use Amazon Brand Analytics, Mercado Libre tools and other sources to understand search behavior, competition and share.

• Integrate sales, traffic, content, inventory and profitability data to generate actionable insights, not just reports.

• Build dashboards and business reviews that explain what is happening, why, what the opportunity is and what action to take.

• Use AI and automation to speed up analysis, detect anomalies, research keywords and trends, optimize content and automate reporting.

Key KPIs: Traffic · CTR · CVR · Share of Search · Sales by channel/SKU · Insights turned into actions.




BUSINESS IMPACT

Level of autonomy

High in daily platform operations — the KAM makes independent decisions on listing optimization, catalog, content and incident response. Escalates to the Business Manager decisions on pricing outside approved guidelines, commercial investment above the authorized range and major account incidents.

Key relationships

• Internal: Amazon and/or Mercado Libre Business Manager, Marketing, Digital Marketing, Customer Marketing, Demand Planning, Supply Chain, Customer Service, Finance, Credit and Logistics.

• External: Vendor Managers and Category Managers at Amazon Mexico, Key Account Managers at Mercado Libre Mexico and digital content agencies.

Problem-solving complexity

Very high. Ecommerce operates in real time — an algorithm change, a listing suppression or a pricing issue can affect sales within hours, not days. The KAM must diagnose platform, commercial and content problems at the same time, with high tolerance for ambiguity and the ability to decide quickly with incomplete information. Pricing decisions on marketplaces can also cascade across other channels.

Interpersonal skills

The role requires fluent executive communication in English and Spanish (platform interfaces and Amazon contacts often operate in English). Ability to explain platform concepts to non-specialist stakeholders (Finance, Supply Chain, management) and to operate with autonomy in a constantly changing environment.

The successful candidate will help turn the category into a scalable, data-driven and highly collaborative growth engine on Mexico’s leading marketplaces.




MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

Education

• Specialization, diploma or certification in ecommerce, digital marketing or marketplace management — desirable. MBA — valuable.

Experience

• Minimum 5 years of experience managing accounts on Amazon Mexico (Vendor Central and/or Seller Central) and Mercado Libre, with direct responsibility for sales and content.

• Proven experience in listing optimization and fulfillment management (FBA or Mercado Libre Full) — required.

• Background in consumer goods, durable goods or retail — preferred.

• Experience building ecommerce channel P&Ls with platform fees, logistics costs and commercial investment — desirable.

• Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders.

Competencies

• Analytical, data-driven mindset — decisions based on platform metrics, not intuition.

• Results orientation and self-management — able to manage multiple platforms and projects without daily supervision.

• Commercial thinking — understands the business beyond the platform: how ecommerce affects other channels and how real profitability differs from gross price.

• Agility and fast learning — marketplace algorithms, policies and tools change constantly.

• Executive communication in English and Spanish.

• Attention to detail — an error in a list price, ASIN category or listing can have immediate commercial impact.

Technical skills — required proficiency

• Amazon Vendor Central: catalog, POs, shortage claims, chargebacks, reports and A+ Content.

• Amazon Seller Central (desirable): listings, FBA shipments, account health and Brand Registry.

• Amazon Brand Analytics: Search Query Performance, Search Funnel Analytics and Market Basket Analysis.

• Mercado Libre Seller Center: listings, variants, catalog, reputation, questions and Mercado Libre Full logistics.

• Advanced Excel: pivot tables, channel P&L models and net pricing simulators.

• Power BI / Tableau / Looker Studio or equivalent: dashboards, data integration and reporting automation.

• Marketplace keyword research tools (Helium 10, Jungle Scout, DataDive or equivalent) — desirable.

• Regular use of artificial intelligence to analyze large volumes of data, detect anomalies, research keywords and trends, optimize content and automate reporting.

• Advanced English — minimum B2+, verifiable.




Other requirements

• Availability to respond to critical platform incidents outside business hours when operations require it.

• Willingness to keep up continuously with changes in marketplace policies, algorithms and tools.

• Experience or willingness to work with digital content agencies and coordinate asset production to marketplace standards.
